s5-lurker.desc: a young man in a gray coat

s5-bench-reader.desc: an old man in a brown cap

extra:attendant.desc: a platform attendant in an orange vest

extra:counterhand.desc: a counter hand in an apron

extra:arrival.desc: a young woman off the train

gray-coat-on-the-bench.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} takes up a post at the platform pillar and stands still.

gray-coat-on-the-bench.1.2.line: {s5-lurker} sits on the platform bench, orange scarf wound high.

gray-coat-on-the-bench.1.3.line: {s5-lurker} stands at the yellow line as the late train stops, then lets the doors close without boarding.

gray-coat-on-the-bench.1.4.line: {s5-lurker} raises one hand toward the attendant booth, where {extra:attendant} stands.

pencil-numbers-under-the-slat.1.1.line: {s5-lurker} sits on the bench writing in pencil on a scrap of paper.

pencil-numbers-under-the-slat.1.2.line: {s5-lurker} walks to the stairs with empty hands.

pencil-numbers-under-the-slat.1.3.line: {night-stakeout-officer} crouches and lifts a paper scrap from under the bench slat.

pencil-numbers-under-the-slat.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} reads the scrap: a column of pencil minute marks, "20, 41, 02."

old-man-on-the-east-bench.1.1.line: {s5-bench-reader} sits on the east bench with a slate in {s5-bench-reader.his} lap.

old-man-on-the-east-bench.1.2.line: {s5-bench-reader} stands at the yellow line for each arriving train, then steps back.

old-man-on-the-east-bench.1.3.line: {s5-bench-reader} sits back down on the east bench, slate on {s5-bench-reader.his} knees.

old-man-on-the-east-bench.1.4.line: {s5-bench-reader} leans on {s5-bench-reader.his} cane and leaves the platform by the stairs.

never-boards.1.1.line: {s5-lurker} comes through the platform gate, orange scarf up.

never-boards.1.2.line: {s5-lurker} sits on the bench while three trains open and close their doors.

never-boards.1.3.line: {s5-lurker} walks to the stairs after the last doors close, never having boarded.

never-boards.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands at the pillar, watching the bench.

cup-on-the-bin-ledge.1.1.line: {extra:attendant} stands at the lost property bin with a paper cup.

cup-on-the-bin-ledge.1.2.line: {extra:attendant} sets the paper cup on the ledge of the lost property bin.

cup-on-the-bin-ledge.1.3.line: {s5-lurker} lifts the cup from the bin ledge and walks off with it.

cup-on-the-bin-ledge.1.4.line: {extra:attendant} chats with {night-stakeout-officer} about the weather and nothing else.

across-from-the-tea-counter.1.1.line: {s5-lurker} sits at the corner table across from the tea counter, scarf on, ordering nothing.

across-from-the-tea-counter.1.2.line: {s5-gray-coat-woman} steps up to the tea counter in a gray coat and orders tea.

across-from-the-tea-counter.1.3.line: {night-stakeout-officer} watches the tea counter from the bath house entrance.

across-from-the-tea-counter.1.4.line: {s5-lurker} gets up from the corner table and leaves without ordering.

last-train-at-the-hatch.1.1.line: {s5-lurker} stands at the lost property hatch after the last train pulls out.

last-train-at-the-hatch.1.2.line: {s5-lurker} says one word through the hatch to {extra:attendant}, too low to catch.

last-train-at-the-hatch.1.3.line: {extra:attendant} pulls the hatch shutter down from inside.

last-train-at-the-hatch.1.4.line: {s5-lurker} turns from the hatch and leaves by the stairs.

last-train-at-the-hatch.1.5.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stays at the pillar, watching the shut hatch.

leaf-chip.1.1.line: {s5-lurker} sits down at the bath house tea counter.

leaf-chip.1.2.line: {extra:counterhand} slides a cup of tea across to {s5-lurker}.

leaf-chip.1.3.line: {s5-lurker} sets a round chip stamped with a leaf on the counter.

leaf-chip.1.4.line: {s5-lurker} finishes the tea and leaves the counter.

old-man-meets-the-17-40.1.1.line: {s5-bench-reader} stands at the yellow line as the train pulls in.

old-man-meets-the-17-40.1.2.line: {extra:arrival} steps off the train and hugs {s5-bench-reader}.

old-man-meets-the-17-40.1.3.line: {s5-bench-reader} and {extra:arrival} walk to the stairs together, arm in arm.

lurker-caught-on-the-platform.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} steps away from the pillar for the first time tonight.

lurker-caught-on-the-platform.1.2.line: {night-stakeout-officer} points at the bench where {s5-lurker} sits.

lurker-caught-on-the-platform.1.3.line: {night-stakeout-officer} arrests {s5-lurker} at the yellow line, and {s5-lurker.he} holds out both wrists.

lurker-caught-on-the-platform.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} empties the coat pockets of {s5-lurker}: a pencil scrap and a leaf-stamped chip.

lurker-caught-on-the-platform.1.5.line: {night-stakeout-officer} walks {s5-lurker} to the stairs in cuffs.

lurker-caught-on-the-platform.1.6.line: {extra:attendant} stands in the booth with one hand on the shutter.

gray-coat-behind-the-counter.1.1.line: {s5-gray-coat-woman} swipes a badge and enters by the staff door behind the counter, gray coat on.

gray-coat-behind-the-counter.1.2.line: {s5-gray-coat-woman} reads the staff rota pinned to the wall.

gray-coat-behind-the-counter.1.3.line: {s5-gray-coat-woman}, now in a pale green apron, pours tea for a patron.

slip-filed.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} hands {desk-sergeant} the pencil scrap in a sealed evidence bag.

slip-filed.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} enters it in the intake log: "Pencil scrap, platform bench. Match to attendant shift sheet."

slip-filed.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} points at tonight's rota on the screen.

slip-filed.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} argues with {desk-sergeant} about overtime: "Three nights at that pillar."

slip-filed.1.5.line: {night-stakeout-officer} walks out of the station at the end of shift.
